pivot_note: pixels from the top-left of each PNG

head_a.desc: skull and upper jaw, eyes open

jaw_a.desc: lower jaw at the hinge; its mouth fan hides behind the head when shut and fills the gap up to ~20 deg open (wider: show mouth_x too)

tongue_a.desc: forked tongue, root at the pivot; lies inside the mouth

mouth_a.desc: inside of the open mouth (bite), pinned to the head at the jaw hinge; behind jaw_x; show when the jaw opens past ~20 deg (covers up to ~45 deg)

head_b.desc: skull and upper jaw, eyes open; tail head: dark crest, scar, heavy lids

head_b_blink.desc: eyes shut; tail head: dark crest, scar, heavy lids

head_b_hurt.desc: eyes squeezed shut (><); tail head: dark crest, scar, heavy lids

jaw_b.desc: lower jaw at the hinge; its mouth fan hides behind the head when shut and fills the gap up to ~20 deg open (wider: show mouth_x too)

tongue_b.desc: forked tongue, root at the pivot; lies inside the mouth

mouth_b.desc: inside of the open mouth (bite), pinned to the head at the jaw hinge; behind jaw_x; show when the jaw opens past ~20 deg (covers up to ~45 deg)

coil_back.desc: back loop of the coil (behind the necks)

coil_front.desc: front loop of the coil (drawn over the necks' bases)

collar.desc: the collar with the compass piece, round neck_a1's middle (in front of it); the band's ends tuck behind the segment's edges

tail_base.desc: c_sl_hizza_tail: the tail coming out of churned dirt; pivot on the ground line under the tail's middle; tail_b1 stacks on the stub's top (about (72, 8))

dizzy_stars.desc: three stars to circle above a dazed head

smoke_puff.desc: defeat smoke; scale up and fade
